knowledge:
- key_parameters: input=Specifies the type of RNA data, either "sRNA" or "mRNA" ;; genomeA/genomeB=Genome FASTA files to merge ;; annotationA/annotationB=GFF annotation files to merge ;; mmap=Multi-mapping read handling (e.g., "n" to exclude multi-mapped reads to avoid ambiguity in chimeric systems) ;; chimeric=Logical parameter in RNAdicercall or RNApopulation to optimize classification/filtering by removing potential mapping errors using control samples ;; genome.ID=Prefix identifier for the foreign/mobile genome (e.g., "B" or "B_") ;; controls=Vector of control sample names (e.g., self-grafts) to filter out background noise/mapping errors ;; task=Action to perform in RNAmobile, either "keep" or "remove" to retain or discard specific clusters ;; method=Method for differential analysis ("DESeq2" or "edgeR") or sequence extraction ("consensus") ;; match=Feature type to match in RNAattributes (e.g., "genes")
- alternatives: Post-alignment screening of genetic variants on a single reference genome (which has high false-positive rates and high dependency on arbitrary thresholds) ;; ShortStack (for sRNA alignment/clustering) and HISAT2/HTSeq/SAMtools (for mRNA alignment/quantification) are used as underlying OS dependencies ;; psRNATarget for downstream target prediction ;; bioseq package for sequence consensus analysis
- when_to_use: When analyzing RNA-seq data (sRNA or mRNA) from chimeric systems (e.g., grafted plants with distinct genotypes, host-pathogen systems) to identify mobile RNAs moving across junctions/boundaries, or when performing standard RNA-seq differential analysis between treatment and control conditions with a focus on sRNA class distribution and population changes (gained/lost populations).
- pitfalls: Windows OS limitation: ShortStack (required for sRNA) is not supported on Windows; Windows users must use WSL or a virtual machine ;; Multi-mapping reads: Multi-mappers should be excluded (mmap = "n") because there is no current method to distinguish whether a read maps to multiple locations within one or both genomes in the merged reference ;; Genome/Annotation mismatch: Any alterations (like prefixes) made to the genome assemblies during merging must be identically replicated in the annotation files, otherwise chromosome names will not align ;; Control sample comparison: If the chimeric partners share high genomic similarity, removing clusters found in control samples might inadvertently remove true mobile RNAs.

workflows.name: srna_mobilome_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify, quantify, and characterize mobile small RNAs (sRNAs) and population-scale changes across graft junctions or chimeric systems.
input: sRNAseq_dir (Directory containing sRNA-seq FASTQ files for self-graft and heterograft samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Merge genome assemblies using RNAmergeGenomes ;; 2. Merge genome annotations using RNAmergeAnnotations ;; 3. Align reads and detect/quantify sRNA clusters using mapRNA ;; 4. Import pre-processed data into R using RNAimport ;; 5. Identify potential mobile sRNA clusters using RNAmobile ;; 6. Perform quality control and plot sRNA class distributions using RNAdistribution, plotSamplePCA, and plotSampleDistance ;; 7. Define consensus dicercall using RNAdicercall and subset populations using RNAsubset ;; 8. Reorder data and perform differential expression analysis using RNAreorder and RNAdifferentialAnalysis ;; 9. Identify gained and lost RNA populations using RNApopulation ;; 10. Perform functional analysis (extract sequences, match attributes, summarize features) using RNAsequences, RNAattributes, RNAfeatures, and plotRNAfeatures
workflows.code:
library("mobileRNA")

# Load small RNA data
data("sRNA_data")

# Load messenger RNA data
data("mRNA_data")

fasta_1 <- system.file("extdata","reduced_chr12_Eggplant.fa.gz", 
                       package="mobileRNA")

fasta_2 <-system.file("extdata","reduced_chr2_Tomato.fa.gz",
                      package="mobileRNA")
# define temporary output directory - replace with your directory
output_assembly_file <- file.path(tempfile("merged_assembly", 
                                           fileext = ".fa"))

# merge
merged_reference <- RNAmergeGenomes(genomeA = fasta_1,
                                    genomeB = fasta_2,
                                    output_file = output_assembly_file)

anno1 <- system.file("extdata","reduced_chr12_Eggplant.gff.gz",
                     package="mobileRNA")

anno2 <- system.file("extdata","reduced_chr2_Tomato.gff.gz", 
                     package="mobileRNA")

# define temporary output directory 
output_annotation_file <- file.path(tempfile("merged_annotation", 
                                             fileext = ".gff3"))

# merge annotation files into a single file
merged_annotation <- RNAmergeAnnotations(annotationA = anno1,
                                         annotationB = anno2,
                                         output_file = output_annotation_file)

# directory containing only sRNAseq samples
samples <- system.file("extdata/sRNAseq",package="mobileRNA")

# output location
output_location <- tempdir()

mapRNA(input = "sRNA",
       input_files_dir = samples,
       output_dir = output_location,
       genomefile = output_assembly_file,
       condaenv = "/Users/user-name/miniconda3/envs/ShortStack4",
       mmap = "n")

# Directory containing results
results_dir <-  file.path(output_location,"2_sRNA_results")

# Sample names and total number of reads, in the same order.
sample_names <- c("selfgraft_demo_1", "selfgraft_demo_2",
                  "selfgraft_demo_3", "heterograft_demo_1",
                  "heterograft_demo_2", "heterograft_demo_3")


sRNA_data_demo <- RNAimport(input = "sRNA",
                            directory = results_dir,
                            samples = sample_names)

data("sRNA_data")

# define control samples
controls <- c("selfgraft_1", "selfgraft_2", "selfgraft_3")

mobile_sRNA <- RNAmobile(input = "sRNA",
                         data = sRNA_data, 
                         controls = controls,
                         genome.ID = "B",
                         task = "keep")

# save output as txt file
write.table(mobile_sRNA, "./sRNA_mobile_output.txt")

# plot each replicate as a line, separately, and facet 
sample_distribution_line <- RNAdistribution(sRNA_data,
                                            style = "line",
                                            overlap =  FALSE, 
                                            facet = TRUE,
                                            colour = "darkgreen")

                                            
 # plot each replicate as a bar, separately, and facet 
sample_distribution_bar <- RNAdistribution(sRNA_data,
                                           style = "bar",
                                           facet = TRUE,
                                           colour ="lightblue")

# View plot (only)
sample_distribution_line$plot

# View plot (only)
sample_distribution_bar$plot

groups <- c("Heterograft", "Heterograft", "Heterograft",
            "Selfgraft", "Selfgraft", "Selfgraft")

 plotSamplePCA(data = sRNA_data, group = groups, size.ratio = 2)

plotSampleDistance(sRNA_data)

# define consensus, store as a data summary file.
sRNA_data_dicercall <- RNAdicercall(data = sRNA_data, 
                                     chimeric = TRUE, 
                                     genome.ID = "B_", 
                                     controls = c("selfgraft_1", 
                                                  "selfgraft_2", 
                                                  "selfgraft_3"))

# Subset data for analysis: 24-nt sRNAs
sRNA_24 <- RNAsubset(sRNA_data_dicercall, class = 24)

# Subset data for analysis: 21/22-nt sRNAs
sRNA_2122 <- RNAsubset(sRNA_data_dicercall, class = c(21, 22))

consensus_plot <- RNAdistribution(data = sRNA_data_dicercall,
                                  style = "bar",
                                  data.type = "consensus")

# view 
consensus_plot$plot

#reorder df
controls <- c("selfgraft_1", "selfgraft_2", "selfgraft_3")
reorder_df <- RNAreorder(sRNA_data_dicercall, controls)

# sample conditions in order within dataframe
groups <- c("Selfgraft", "Selfgraft", "Selfgraft", 
            "Heterograft", "Heterograft", "Heterograft")

## Differential analysis of whole dataset: DESeq2 method 
sRNA_DESeq2 <- RNAdifferentialAnalysis(data = reorder_df,
                              group = groups,
                              method = "DESeq2")

RNAsummary(sRNA_DESeq2)

RNAsummary(sRNA_DESeq2, alpha=0.05)

write.table(sRNA_DESeq2, "./sRNA_core_dataset.txt")

# summary of statistical sRNA clusters
RNAsummary(sRNA_DESeq2, alpha=0.05)

# select significant 
significant_sRNAs <-  sRNA_DESeq2[sRNA_DESeq2$padjusted < 0.05, ]

p1 <- plotHeatmap(significant_sRNAs, value = "RPM", row.names = FALSE,
                  title = "Heatmap of log-transformed FPKM")

p1$plot

# select sRNA clusters only found in treatment & not in the control samples
gained_sRNA <- RNApopulation(data = sRNA_DESeq2, 
                                  conditions = c("heterograft_1", 
                                                 "heterograft_2" , 
                                                 "heterograft_3"),
                                  chimeric = TRUE, 
                                  genome.ID = "B_", 
                                  controls = c("selfgraft_1",
                                               "selfgraft_2", 
                                               "selfgraft_3"))

# look at number of sRNA cluster only found in treatment 
nrow(gained_sRNA)

# select sRNA clusters only found in control & not in the treatment samples
lost_sRNA <- RNApopulation(data = sRNA_DESeq2, 
                                conditions = c("selfgraft_1", 
                                               "selfgraft_2" , 
                                               "selfgraft_3"), 
                                  chimeric = TRUE, 
                                  genome.ID = "B_", 
                                  controls = c("selfgraft_1",
                                               "selfgraft_2", 
                                               "selfgraft_3"))
# look at number of sRNA cluster only found in control  
nrow(lost_sRNA)

gained_sRNA_sequences <- RNAsequences(gained_sRNA, method = "consensus" )

gained_sRNA_attributes <- RNAattributes(data = gained_sRNA, 
                                        match ="genes",
                            annotation = output_annotation_file)

# vector of control names
control_names <- c("selfgraft_1", "selfgraft_2", "selfgraft_3")

## Identify potential tomato mobile molecules
mobile_sRNA <- RNAmobile(input = "sRNA",
                        data = sRNA_DESeq2, 
                         controls = control_names,
                         genome.ID = "B_",
                         task = "keep", 
                         statistical = FALSE)

p2 <- plotHeatmap(mobile_sRNA, row.names = FALSE)

p2$plot

write.table(mobile_sRNA, "./candidate_mobile_sRNAs.txt")

annotation_file <- system.file("extdata",
                     "prefix_reduced_chr2_Tomato.gff", 
                     package="mobileRNA")

mobile_attributes <- RNAattributes(data = mobile_sRNA, 
                                      match ="genes",
                                      annotation = annotation_file)

mobile_features <- RNAfeatures(data = mobile_sRNA, 
                               annotation = annotation_file)
print(mobile_features)

# plot as stacked bar chart
features_plot <- plotRNAfeatures(data = mobile_sRNA,  
                                 annotation = annotation_file)

plot(features_plot)

mobile_sequences <- RNAsequences(mobile_sRNA, method = "consensus") 

write.table(mobile_sequences, "./candidate_mobile_sRNA_sequences.txt")

# load `dplyr` package
library(dplyr)

# select the cluster and sequence columns 
sequences <- mobile_sequences %>% select(Cluster, Sequence)

# add prefix, remove row with NA
prefix <- ">"
sequences$Cluster <- paste0(prefix, sequences$Cluster)
sequences <- na.omit(sequences)

# convert to required format:
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq(nrow(sequences)), 
                             function(i) t(sequences[i, ])))

# save output
write.table(res, file ="./mobile_sRNA_sequences.txt",
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# load `bioseq` package
library(bioseq)

# build a RNA vector from a character vector:
mobileRNA_seq <- bioseq::rna(mobile_sequences$Sequence)

# Find a consensus sequence for a set of sequences:
bioseq::seq_consensus(mobileRNA_seq)
